content: Jesús, Jerusalén-neggweburgi reyyob dogsad
Jesús e-sapinganmala Jerusalén-modanimargu, Olivos-yar-dikarba, Betfagé-neggwebur-walikgusgu, e-sapingan-warbo barmisad.
Barmisgu, ega weyob sogsad: —Neggwebur-bipi-anmar-asabin-siidse be namar. Agi be moli-uayasuid-atinnar-nai, degi, e-mimmi-e-dikarba-gudii be dakdapmaloed. A-molimar be esikmalo, geb be anse sedamalo.
Ar dule-wargwen bemarga akar sokardibe, ega be sogmalo: ‘Ar Dummad sogye, ede bina-sogye. Ebusad-sorba bega gannar yog-sear imakoye.’
Ar we deyob bela we-ibmar-gusadi, igi Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged sogsagusa, deyob-guegala gunonikid, deun sogsagusgu:
Zacarías 9:9
Jesús-sapingan-warbogwad nadmarsunnad. Jesús ega igi sogsa, deyob, imakdapmalad.
Jesús-sapingan moli-uayasuid, degi, e-mimmi, Jesúsʼse senonimalad. Geb degi, a-moli-birgi e-mormar ogichamargu, a-birgi Jesús sigisad. Jesús moli-birgi-sigisgu, Jerusalénʼse nadsunnad.
Dulemar-bukidara, Jesús-iduar igargi e-mormar-ogitemalad. Abala ogob-gagangiid gwane-gwane imakdemalad, geb Jesús-iduar igargi mese-mese imaksamalad.
Ar dulemar-bukidar-idu-nadapmaladi, degi, sorba-danimaladi, binnasur gornadapmalad, sognadapmalad:
Salmo 118:26
Jesús Jerusalénʼse-dogdapgu, bela Jerusalénʼginmalad oimakdemalad, sogdemalad: —¿Wede doasunna?
Dulemar-bukidarad-Jesúsʼba-danimalad sogdemalad: —We-dule, Jesús Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged, Nazaret-neggweburginedid, Galilea-yarginedid.
Jesús, Babse-goled-neggi ibmar-ukbukmalad onosad

Jesús Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse-dogdapgu, bela dulemar-ibmar-baknanaid, degi, ibmar-ukbukmalad sabsur-onisad. Degi, dulemar-mani-ogwabukmalad-e-mese binnasur-barbikiin meted, degi, dulemar nuu-ukbukmalad-e-gan barbikiin metebalid.
Jesús amarga sogded: —Bab-Dummad-Gardagi narmakar naid:
Isaías 56:7 ”Ar emigindi bemardi atursamalad-negga imaksamalad.”
Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi, dulemar-ibyasurmalad, degi, dulemar-nue-geg-nanamalad Jesúsʼse-nonimargu, Jesús amar bela-nudaksad.

Deginbali, burwigana-bukidar Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi oimakbukwad, sogbukwad: “¡We David-Wagwa, e-nug odummomar!” Geb dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan, degi, Garda-Narmaked-Dulemar Jesús-ibmar-dakledisulid-imaknai-dakedba, degine, burwigana-oimakbukwa-itosmaladba, sae-itodmalad, Jesúsʼgi uludmalad.
Amar Jesúsʼga sogdemalad: —¿Burwigana ibmar sogbukmalad be itoge? Jesús, abin-sogded: —Eye, an itoge. ”¿Ar bemar Bab-Dummad-Gardagi absodisurmarsi?
Salmo 8:2
Agi, Jesús, Judío-dummagan-mete naded, Betania-e-neggweburse nadegusad. Geb agi megidapid.
Jesús higuera-sapi ukabsasad
Oibosgu, Jesús wakdar Jerusalén-neggweburse-gannar-danigu, ukur itoalid.

Igar-dikarba higuera-sapi-gwichi-dakargu, ese nadegusad. Ese modapgu, san sate dakalid, unnila e-gaganbi-nika dakalid. Jesús a-sapiga sogdesunnad: —Bipisaale bar gwen be durbamakosur. Agi higuera-sapi yog-dinguar naded.
Jesús-e-sapingan higuera-sapi dingud-gusad-daksagu, geger dakdemalad, sogdemalad: —¿Ar wede ibiga gwae-gwae higuera-sapi dingude?

Jesús abin-sogded: —Napira an bemarga soged. Ar bemar ibmar-imaknaid nue-bensulile, we-sapi-higuera-an-imaksayobi, be abi imaksasurmalaled. Ar sunna we-yarga be sogsamalaled: ‘Wegi be siid be ainir, demarse be nae,’ ar bemar-sogedba gusaled.
Ar bela be nue-bensuli Bab-Dummadse-goledgi be egisele, be-ibmar-egised be abingaodo.
Jesúsʼga sogmalad: ¿Doa-nuggi be ibmar imakye?

Jesús Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse-nonikid. Agi emar-odurdaksigu, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan, degi, Judío-girmar-dummagan ese nonimalad. Ega sogdemalad: —¿Doa-nuggine wede be we-ibmar imakdii? ¿Ar doa bega igar uksasunna?
Jesús abin-sogded: —An bemarse ibmar-soggwen egismogodo. Bemar an-abin-imaksale, geb an bemarga sogmogoed, an we-ibmar-imakega, wede doa anga igar-uksa.

An bese egismosun, Diigi-dule-oged-Juan, Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-imaksad, we, ¿bia daniki? ¿Bab-Dummad barmiali? ¿Dulemar barmiali? Anga be sogmalana. Degi-itosmargu, Judío-dummagan muchub-muchub na sogdemalad: “Anmar sogmalale, Bab-Dummad Diigi-dule-oged-Juan-barmiarye, anmarga sogdagoed, ‘degite, ¿ibiga bemar Diigi-dule-oged-Juan-bengusmarsunna?’
Anmar sogbalile, dulemar Diigi-dule-oged-Juan-barmiarye, anmarse neggwebur urwedagoed. Ar ade, bela sogmalad, ‘Diigi-dule-oged-Juan, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-sunnadye.’ ”

Degisoggu, Judío-dummagan, Jesús-abin sogdemarsunnad: —Anmar wissurmalad, doa Diigi-dule-oged-Juan barmiali. Degi, Jesús, abin-imakdemosunnad: —An bemarga sogosurmarmodo, wede doa-nuggi we-ibmar an imakdii.
Machimala-warbogwadgi burbar sunmaklenaid
Jesús Judío-dummaganga sogded: “We-ibmar an bemarga-sogoedi be igi-binsamalodibe. Dule-wargwen machimala warbo nikad. A-dulede e-machi-wargwenga sogded: ‘Machi, an-nainuse be arbana, uva eminae.’
Machi, e-bab-abin-imakded, sogded: ‘Yapa an nae.’ Geb a-sorba, bukib-itoargu, nadegusad, arbanad gusad.
Bab e-machi-baidse nadbalid, ega amba deyob sogdapbalid: ‘An-nainuse be uva eminae.’ E-machi-baid e-bab-abin sogded: ‘Baba, eye, an arbanao.’ Ar degite, we-machidi arbanadsurgusad.”

Jesús Judío-dummaganse egisdesunnad: —We-masmala-warbogwad, ¿doa bur e-bab-sogedba ibmar imaksa be insae? Abin-sogdemalad: —Machigwa arbaapid. Jesús emarga sogded: —Deyobdo. Ar napira an bemarga soged, dulemar-Roma-dummadga-mani-gaedgi-arbamalad, degi, omegan-gambasamalad, amar bur bemarba Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaidse dogoed.

Ar bemarse Juan igar-napiragwadgi sunmaknonimar-inigwele, bemar eba ib-imaksasurmalad. Ar Roma-dummadga-mani-gaedgi-arbamaladdi, degi, omegan-gambasamaladdi, e-sogsad bengussurmalad. Ar bemar a-ibmar daksamarmo-inigwele, bemar we-igar abingamogaga, degite, gwagegala, be-isguedga gwen bukib be itossurmalad.
Arbamalad-isganagi burbar sunmaklesad

Jesús Judío-dummaganga sogdebalid: “Igar-burbar-baid-maid be itomarbalo: Ibagwengi dule-wargwen-nainu-ibedi, e-nainugi na uva-digsad. Geb bela egi galu ebiris-imaksad. A-abargi uva-egured sobsabalid. Geb degi, bela nainugi nakulegegala, aila-matusulid sobsabalid. Dule-nainu-ibed dulemar-arbamaladga e-nainu-urmaksad, adi, a-dulemar nainugi uva-wealir, e-ibedga wis ukmogagar. Deyob ebo igar mesisad. Geb nainu-ibeddi neggwebur-baidse dikasur nadsunnad.
”Uva-weed-ibagan-mosgu, nainu-ibed uva-na-egadid-suega, e-nainugi-arbamaladse e-maigan-barmisad.
”Ar nainugi-arbamaladdi, nainu-ibed-e-maigan-ese-nonimargu, gasmalad. Geb gwensak sarsosmalad, baiddi oburgwismalad. Mai-baiddi akwagi maksamalad.
A-sorba, nainu-ibed e-maigan-baigan bur melu barmidbarsunnad. Degine, amba deyob sabsur-imaksamarbalid.
”Napidgi, nainu-ibed e-machi-barmiarsunnad, ar ade, binsaded: ‘An-machisoggu, gwen oakalogosurmar an insaye.’
”Ar nainugi-arbamalad, nainu-ibed-machi dani dakarmargu, na ega sogdemalad: ‘We-dule-danikidi e-bab-burgwisar, nainu bela egadbi guoed. Degisoggu, anmar ei nainu suega, anmar we-machi oburgwemarsun.’
Machigwa-gasmargu, nainu-magaba metemalad, geb agi oburgwismalad.”
Jesús Judío-dummaganse egisded: —Ar nainu-ibed e-nainuse nonikir, ¿igi nainugi-arbamalad-imaknoniko be insae?
Jesús-abin sogdemalad: —Ar nainu-ibed-nonikogu, bela sabsuli nainugi-arbamalad-isganamar-oburgwenonikoed. Na e-nainu, baigan-arbamaladga urmaknonikoed, adi, amar iba-sekalaa ega e-uva ukmalagar.
Jesús Judío-dummaganga sogded: —¿Ar bemarde Bab-Dummad-Gardagi absodisurmarsi? Bab-Dummad-Garda soged:
”Degisoggu, an bemarga sogmar, Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid-bemargadid, be-annik sulemaloed. Dulemar-baigan-nabir-ibmar-nuegan-imakmaloedga uklegoed.
[Ar dule-wargwen we-akwa-nuedgi argwachale, we-dule bibisgoed. Ar we-akwa dulegi-argwachardi, we-dule ese ubigwar guoed.”]
Jesús we-igar-burbar-sunmaklemaladgi-sunmaksadi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan, degi, Fariseoʼmar, magar itosmalad, Jesúsʼde emargi sunmake.
Amar, Jesús-gabi guarmalanad, degi-inigwele, oakalossurgusmalad, ar ade, neggwebur-dobgusmalad. Ar dulemarde we-Jesús Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogedye-nik sogmalad.
